title: Control of chironomid larvae growth and inactivation mechanisms by UV/ClO2: efficacy and pathways
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,636-649
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00863H, Paper
Hailing Jiang, Ping Xiang, Jun Wu, Rongsheng Zhou, Longfeng Ji, Pan Shu, Kezhen Xu
The combined UV/ClO2 process achieves 100% inactivation of chironomid larvae within 7 hours by inducing membrane permeabilization and oxidative stress, offering an eco-friendly and cost-effective solution for controlling this biological pollutant.
